observations: White portable air cooler with a teal-colored top trim.
Brand name 'Scanfrost' is visible on the top trim in photo 1.
The unit has a large front grille, a water tank compartment at the bottom, and four caster wheels.
A power cord with a 3-pin plug is visible on the floor.
The unit shows some dust and minor surface wear on the front grille and base.

claims.evidence: photo 1 shows the brand and type
photos show the exterior but do not demonstrate operation or cooling performance

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly. Original receipt and warranty available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Cooling performance may be poor or the fan may not work.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit running with mist or cool air blowing out.

risks.risk: The water tank may be cracked or leaking.
risks.proof: A photo of the tank with water inside or a video of it filling.

risks.risk: The internal motor or pump may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the unit powered on and the water pump in operation.

proof_requests: Video of the unit powered on and cooling.
Photo of the water tank with water inside.
Photo of the manufacturer's specification plate (usually on the back or side).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
